personas.name: Australia Cohort
personas.description: Australian DoorDash user. Category mix and notification reachability differ from the US baseline; grocery is a larger share of demand in this market.
personas.jtbd: Get household and grocery essentials via DoorDash in a market with fewer restaurant alternatives.

personas.name: Notification-Fatigued Engaged User
personas.description: Orders regularly but marketing volume exceeds tolerance. Uninstalls and unsubscribes spike after notification campaigns. Sensitive to push/email frequency.
personas.jtbd: Order when needed; aggressively reduce promotional noise from the app and brand.

personas.name: Average Engaged User — high Device Type Notif
personas.description: Steady, moderate-frequency DoorDash user. Restaurant-leaning category mix, average notification engagement, mainstream behavior with no strongly distinctive signals. Most distinctive: channel_tech_behavior.device_type_notif_ (+3.09σ).
personas.jtbd: Get reliably delivered meals as a regular convenience tool.

personas.name: Average Engaged User — low Nv Order Frequency 28D
personas.description: Steady, moderate-frequency DoorDash user. Restaurant-leaning category mix, average notification engagement, mainstream behavior with no strongly distinctive signals. Most distinctive: behavioral_patterns.nv_order_frequency_28d (-0.58σ).
personas.jtbd: Get reliably delivered meals as a regular convenience tool.

personas.name: Average Engaged User — high Notification Message Type Remi
personas.description: Steady, moderate-frequency DoorDash user. Restaurant-leaning category mix, average notification engagement, mainstream behavior with no strongly distinctive signals. Most distinctive: channel_tech_behavior.notification_message_type_REMINDERS (+0.59σ).
personas.jtbd: Get reliably delivered meals as a regular convenience tool.

personas.name: Grocery Stockup Power User
personas.description: Uses DoorDash as a weekly grocery delivery channel. NV-order frequency is materially above baseline; restaurant share is below average. Large basket sizes on a predictable cadence.
personas.jtbd: Replace the weekly trip to the grocery store with predictable home delivery.

personas.name: Caviar SMS Loyalist
personas.description: Orders on the Caviar brand surface (not core DoorDash). SMS-reachable, not push-heavy. Expectations of restaurant quality and brand tone differ from mainstream DD users.
personas.jtbd: Order from premium/curated restaurants on a brand they trust, with low promotional noise.
